description:
Goal
The telemetry arc is complete only when every handler derives presentation data from raw authority references and the full suite proves that contract. Emitters remain lazy and pass minimal borrowed authorities; handlers that retain data copy it themselves.

Baseline proof
On fz-1ah/integration at ca59b76ac, source_publication_defers_local_macro_expansion_until_function_demand failed because the macro-expanded test still expected scalar measurements that the raw-reference emitter removed. Further audit showed the original emitter guard could be bypassed by iterator counts, tuple fields/casts, arbitrary helpers, aggregate allocation, pre-bound projections, and closure-bound projections. Native codegen also traversed complete CLIF bodies and compiled buffers solely to construct telemetry.

Strategy
Use a positive emitter grammar rather than a blacklist: payload values may be direct literals/constants, raw function or pattern bindings, recursively raw local aliases, immutable borrows, or one opaque(raw) wrapper. Reject calls, methods, fields, casts, macros, indexing, aggregates, and transformed aliases. Pass World plus stable keys when World owns the fact; otherwise pass the raw owning artifact. Move all projection into synchronous handlers. Delete unconsumed ABI, callable-boundary, closure-call, receive, CLIF-stat, and code-buffer summaries rather than recreating them elsewhere. Keep artifact correctness in NativeProgram/CLIF/runtime assertions. Migrate JSONL, semantic dump, CLIF dump, fixture-matrix, timeout, pull-session, and codegen tests to raw callback projection.

Signal
Adversarial and green-control provenance fixtures pass. A production NullTelemetry JIT probe records zero handler projections. The dump CLI, reusable-cons fixture consumers, bounded public trace, 1,409-test library suite, all-target check, strict clippy, and release build pass. The warm release fixture is 0.05s real / 0.07s user / 0.03s sys with and without JSON telemetry, emits no diagnostics, and writes 1,085 events / 268,708 bytes. The change removes more source than it adds and introduces no production shadow state or telemetry-only traversal.
title: Migrate raw-authority telemetry handlers and audit event payloads
